meta.name: Library
meta.shortDescription: One-URL unified media library for Dogebox
meta.longDescription: Front-end for the existing Radarr + Sonarr + Prowlarr + Jellyfin stack. One search box across movies and shows, one-click add, starter packs, IMDb/Trakt watchlist import, and a free-text 'Tonight' recommender. Behind the scenes it just calls the existing pup APIs — no new indexers, no new download pipeline, no new library model.
